# pve_node_storages (Data Source)

Lists every storage visible on a node with its runtime status, as reported by `GET /nodes/{node}/storage`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright IBM Corp. 2021, 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "pve_node_storages" "pve1" {
  node = "pve1"
}

output "pve1_storages" {
  value = data.pve_node_storages.pve1.storages
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name whose storages to list.

### Optional

- `content` (String) Only list stores which support this content type. One of the PVE content types: `images`, `rootdir`, `vztmpl`, `iso`, `backup`, `snippets`, `import`. PVE filters the list upstream.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier for the node storage index.
- `storages` (Attributes List) Storages on the node with their runtime status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storages))

<a id="nestedatt--storages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storages`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the storage is accessible; null when the API did not report it.
- `avail` (Number) Available storage space in bytes; null when the API did not report it.
- `content` (List of String) Allowed storage content types.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the storage is enabled (not disabled); null when the API did not report it.
- `shared` (Boolean) Shared flag from the storage configuration; null when the API did not report it.
- `storage` (String) The storage identifier.
- `total` (Number) Total storage space in bytes; null when the API did not report it.
- `type` (String) Storage type (the plugin name, e.g. `dir`, `nfs`, `zfspool`).
- `used` (Number) Used storage space in bytes; null when the API did not report it.
- `used_fraction` (Number) Used fraction (used/total); null when the API did not report it.
